sh: bright room of blocks, finger paints and tiny chairs
f: Twenty toddlers. One teacher. Pray for the teacher.

sh: paper-walled hall with mats, a gong and a row of belts
f: Bow first. Then bonk.

sh: steamy pool, hot stones, cucumber slices on eyes
f: Cucumber on the eyes. Cannot see you. Do not care.

sh: row of spinning round-door washers overflowing with foam
f: Lost: one sock. Found: someone else's sock.

sh: columned hall wrapped in miles of red tape and forms
f: Please fill in form 27B. In triplicate.

sh: sprawl growing from huts to towers to rockets in a blink
f: From mud huts to moon rockets. One more turn.

sh: long scroll of numbered rules with a wagging finger
f: Rule one: no fun. Rule two: see rule one.

sh: grey suit with a calculator and a sack labelled YOURS
f: Takes a third. Then a bit more. Then a form.

sh: ballot box with paper slips flying in and a big tick
f: The votes are in. You came third. Out of one.

sh: judge bench with a gavel, twelve frowning jurors
f: OBJECTION! Overruled. Guilty of losing.

sh: fluffy paint roller laying down a fat orange stripe
f: One coat. Then you. Then a second coat.

sh: fluffy pink feather duster flicking clouds of dust
f: Achoo! Bless you. Achoo! Bless... achoo!

sh: brass hose nozzle on full jet blast
f: Set to JET. Never set it to jet.

sh: little screen with a blue arrow and a calm robotic voice
f: In 200 feet, make a U-turn. Into the lake.

sh: golden slip reading ADMIT ONE with a punched hole
f: Admit one. Violence not included. Bring your own.

sh: dashed-edge paper slip reading 50% OFF with scissors
f: 50% off your health bar. Today only.

sh: absurdly long curling paper strip that keeps printing
f: Three miles long. For one pack of gum.

sh: envelope stamped FINAL NOTICE in red, little window
f: The scariest thing in the letterbox.

sh: scroll of tiny print with a dotted line and a quill hovering
f: Sign here. And here. Initial here. Soul here.

sh: small navy booklet with a gold crest and a terrible photo
f: Worst photo of your life. Valid ten years.

sh: plastic card with a startled photo and a hologram
f: Licence to bonk. Expires never.

sh: rattling shower of little brown biscuit shapes
f: Shake the bag. Every pet for a mile arrives.

sh: muddy fenced pen with a trough and snoozing pigs
f: Your room, according to your mother.

sh: curved steel blade carving a furrow, dirt peeling aside
f: Turns fields over. Enemies too.

sh: steaming dark heap with a sprout bursting out the top
f: Smells awful. Plants love it. Plants are weird.

sh: falling bricks, bent girders, a tyre and one bathtub
f: Used to be something. Now it is incoming.

sh: thick brown-green ooze glugging from a pipe
f: Do not ask where it came from.

sh: greasy grey-brown smear with fingerprints in it
f: Under the fridge since the dawn of time.

sh: wavy green stink lines rising from an old trainer
f: Whoever smelt it, dealt it.

sh: roadside drain grate with rushing water and a lost ball
f: Every lost ball ends up here.

sh: heavy round iron lid with a grid pattern, steam leaking
f: Round so it cannot fall in. Unlike you.

sh: thick flat grey stone rectangle dropping flat
f: Flat. Heavy. Final.

sh: glowing figure-eight track sending things back to start
f: See flavour text: loop.

sh: glowing cyan wireframe squares stretching out
f: Stay inside the lines. Or get zapped.

sh: string of little triangle flags fluttering
f: Go team! Whichever team. This is generic bunting.

sh: jagged white sound spikes shattering nearby glass
f: EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE.

sh: pulsing purple rings with a thumping speaker cone
f: WUB WUB WUB WUB. Drop incoming.

sh: pair of wide unblinking eyes with dotted sight lines
f: Staring contest. It does not have eyelids.

sh: narrowed sideways eyes over folded arms
f: Mum gave you The Look. It is over.

sh: two identical figures pointing at each other
f: Ctrl C. Ctrl V. Ctrl V. Ctrl V. Ctrl V.

sh: round kitchen timer ticking down from ten, shaking
f: Three. Two. One. Ding.

sh: minty blue-green swoosh pouring from a cap
f: Burns for thirty seconds. Fresh for six minutes.

sh: soft white tissue floating up out of a box, then another
f: Bless you. Have one. Have the whole box.

sh: hail of rounded grey paving stones
f: The street is coming to you.

sh: burst pillow snowstorm of white feathers
f: The pillow lost. Everybody loses.

sh: springy cream fluff bundle with one sheep ear sticking out
f: Itchy. Warm. Baa-rely a threat.

sh: layered tan and orange stone block shedding grit
f: A beach that got serious.

sh: thin dark grey stone tile spinning edge-first
f: Wiped clean. With your face.

sh: arched window of jewel-coloured panes casting rainbow light
f: Pretty. Holy. Extremely breakable.

sh: shower of bright bottles, tubs and one lonely fork
f: Will outlive us all. Especially you.

sh: stretchy black sheet snapping back like a trampoline
f: I am rubber. You are glue.

sh: big brown box with eye holes sneaking along
f: Not a box. A stealth vehicle.

sh: rolled newspaper thwacking down, headline: SUMMON WINS
f: Extra! Extra! Read all about your defeat!

sh: tough blue jacket with brass studs and a patch
f: Double denim. Double defence.

sh: plush red rope on gold posts across the way
f: Are you on the list? You are not on the list.

sh: flowing shimmering pastel ribbon looping through the air
f: Smooth. Too smooth. Suspiciously smooth.

sh: creaky brown biker jacket with a popped collar and studs
f: Creaks when it moves. Cooler than you.

sh: drifting puffs of soft white fluff
f: Soft. Gentle. In your ears.

sh: spreading blue-black splat with a quill stuck in it
f: What do you see? A butterfly? It is a splat.

sh: dribbling warm yellow wax pooling and hardening
f: Mind your own. Beeswax, that is.

sh: flying blue-and-white teacups, plates and a vase
f: Grandma's best set. She will know.

sh: square glossy bathroom tile spinning like a disc
f: Slippery when wet. Sharp when thrown.

sh: rough grey slab with a boot print and a kid's initials
f: Somebody always writes their name in it.

sh: shower of forks, knives and one bent spoon
f: Elbows off the table. Forks in the air.

sh: smooth polished green stone carved like a little dragon
f: Lucky. Smooth. Greener than envy.

sh: blast of sound from shiny golden horns and a tuba
f: Bold as it. Loud as it.

sh: sharp dark stone striking steel with a spray of sparks
f: One spark. That is all it takes. Twelve tries.

sh: steaming black road sheet being unrolled like carpet
f: Hot. Sticky. Smells like summer roadworks.

sh: long red steel beam swinging from a crane hook
f: Lunch break is over.

sh: polished five-spoke silver wheel spinning
f: Two metals. One shiny problem.

sh: flaky golden swirl with icing and a jam centre
f: Flaky. Like your teammate.

sh: splash of milk cartons, cheese wedges and yogurt pots
f: Got milk? Got cheese? Got hit?

sh: whole crusty brown loaf swung like a club
f: Use your loaf. On them.

sh: curling yellowed sheet with burnt edges and faded ink
f: Ye olde paper. Smells of wizard.

sh: loop of bright flowers flung like a lasso
f: Aloha. You are now decorated. And stuck.

sh: wind-up pink gums and white teeth hopping and chattering
f: Grandpa wants them back. They do not want to go.

sh: two clicking needles weaving a scarf around the target
f: Knit one. Purl one. Wrap one enemy.

sh: puffs of white fluff bursting from a split seam
f: Teddy had a little accident.

sh: red stapler snapping out a stream of tiny silver staples
f: Ka-chunk. Ka-chunk. Attached.

sh: tangle of copper pipes with one joint spraying water
f: The plumber said Tuesday. Which Tuesday? Unknown.

sh: long bendy foam noodle swung like a sword, bonk lines
f: Bonk. Harmless. Bonk. Annoying. Bonk.

sh: tight metal spiral compressed then launching upward
f: Compressed anger. With a boing.

sh: banana peel, spilled paint and a ladder mid-topple
f: It was like that when you got here. Promise.

sh: backpack, treasure map, compass and walking stick
f: Pack snacks. Adventure is mostly walking.

sh: lazy golden sun at three o'clock with a snoozing cat
f: School is out. Snacks are in.

sh: ripple that sprouts grey beards and walking sticks
f: Getting old is mandatory. Growing up is optional.

sh: thick book of embarrassing photos falling open
f: Baby photos. In front of your friends.

sh: crinkly silver sheet shaped into a pointy hat
f: Blocks mind control. Allegedly.

sh: wobbly metal mast with rabbit ears and a blinking red light
f: Hold it just there. Do not move. Perfect.

sh: podium with a banging gavel and numbered paddles
f: Going once. Going twice. Sold to the summon!

sh: shiny gold star sticker with a blue ribbon tail
f: Participation award. Still counts.

sh: avalanche of suitcases, duffels and one guitar case
f: Your bags went to a different city. They liked it.

sh: railed ledge with flower pots and someone waving
f: Wherefore art thou? Down there. Getting hit.

sh: chunky chocolate bar in a half-torn red wrapper
f: Raising it. Then eating it.

sh: striped barrier arm, booth and a passport stamp
f: Papers, please.

sh: yellow-and-black striped road hump
f: Slow down. Too late. Coffee everywhere.

sh: tied-up cluster of mismatched things in a ribbon
f: Why have one when you can have a bunch?

sh: big corrugated steel box lowered on four cables
f: Contents: 40,000 rubber ducks. Really.

sh: rubbery bouncy character with white gloves and pie-cut eyes
f: Runs off the cliff. Only falls when it looks down.

sh: page reading CHAPTER 1 flipping to CHAPTER 2
f: To be continued...

sh: hero with spiky hair, plot armour and a dramatic scarf
f: Main character energy. Plot armour included.

sh: rough lumpy grey-brown lump of something
f: A chunk of what? Best not to ask.

sh: magnifying glass over a glowing footprint
f: It was the butler. In the library. With a summon.

sh: two bumper cars meeting nose to nose, stars flying
f: They did not see each other. They do now.

sh: brick wall, microphone stand and a laugh track sign
f: Tough crowd. Tougher summon.

sh: big black comma hooking like a tiny scythe
f: Let's eat, grandma. Punctuation saves lives.

sh: glass office with a logo, suits and a rising chart
f: Your summon is important to us. Please hold.

sh: clear plastic tub with a lid that never fits
f: The lid exists. Somewhere. Not here.

sh: small brown cork popping at high speed
f: POP! Right in the eye. Every time.

sh: two walls meeting, a cobweb and a stubbed-toe star
f: Go and stand in it. Think about it.

sh: wooden rocking cradle with a mobile of stars
f: Rock-a-bye, enemy. Down will come everything.

sh: ring of golden pizza crust with a bite out
f: Cut the crusts off. Throw the crusts.

sh: springy ginger hair coil boinging about
f: Boing. Boing. Humidity made it stronger.

sh: red number with a minus sign that keeps getting bigger
f: It follows you. It grows. It knows your address.

sh: 52 playing cards fanned and flung edge-first
f: 52 pickup. The violent edition.

sh: dark blue drop-off fading to black, one glowing lure
f: No floaties allowed in the deep end.

sh: pink book with a heart padlock snapping shut
f: KEEP OUT. This means you. Especially you.

sh: single lettuce leaf on a huge plate with a tape measure
f: Starts tomorrow. It always starts tomorrow.

sh: empty door frame with a WELCOME mat and a low beam
f: Mind your head. Too late.

sh: glowing green EXIT sign over a push-bar door
f: This way out. No re-entry.

sh: swirling rainbow tie-dye splash soaking outward
f: Now you are purple. That is permanent, by the way.

sh: compass needle snapping to N with a blast of frost
f: Never Eat Soggy Waffles. Starts here.

sh: compass needle swinging to S with a warm sandy gust
f: Everything went south. Including you.

sh: compass needle on E with a rising sun flare
f: Where the sun gets up. Earlier than you.

sh: compass needle on W, tumbleweed and a setting sun
f: Go west, young summon. Mind the tumbleweed.

sh: flashing red and blue lights with a spinning beacon
f: Remain calm. AAAAAAH. I said remain calm.

sh: rolling wave of faces: happy, sad, angry, surprised
f: Happy. Sad. Furious. Hungry. All in one minute.

sh: red-hot line wrapped round a globe, palm trees wilting
f: The world's belt. It is on the tightest notch.

sh: sweatband figure doing star jumps beside a dumbbell
f: One more rep. That was a lie. Ten more.

sh: bolt of patterned cloth unrolling over everything
f: Cut from the same cloth. Wrapped in it too.

sh: model striking a pose under flashing cameras
f: Darling, that armour is SO last season.

sh: open book with a cardboard crown and a cloud castle
f: None of this is real. It still hurts.

sh: sparkly screen that adds dog ears to anything behind it
f: Dog ears and sparkles. Nobody is safe.

sh: drifting golden cereal flakes and a splash of milk
f: Soggy in thirty seconds. Eat fast.

sh: swirl of colours with a licking tongue and sparkles
f: Mystery flavour. It is always blue raspberry.

sh: trail of muddy prints walking by themselves
f: Somebody did not wipe their feet.

sh: iron box with a glowing grate, pipes and a roaring door
f: The basement monster. It heats the house.

sh: falling sofa, wardrobe, lamp and one leftover screw
f: Self-assembly. Three screws left over. Hmm.

sh: blur of hooves and coconut-shell clip-clop lines
f: Clippity clop. Two coconut halves, really.

sh: cluster of people all talking at once with coffee cups
f: This could have been an email.

sh: looping arrow circle with a bitten fingernail
f: Hard to break. Easy to summon.

sh: teetering mound of assorted stuff with a sock on top
f: It is not a mess. It is a system.

sh: throbbing red rings round a head with tiny hammers
f: Ate the ice cream too fast. Worth it.

sh: model plane, stamp album, yarn ball and a half-done jigsaw
f: Started twelve. Finished none.

sh: endless glowing line where orange sky meets dark sea
f: Walk toward it forever. It keeps the distance.

sh: falling trumpet, drum, violin and a honking kazoo
f: The whole band. Dropped from a height.

sh: dotted line across a map with a tiny car and suitcase
f: Are we there yet? No. Now? No. Now?

sh: sticky white label slapped on with HELLO written on it
f: Labelled: property of the winner.

sh: two untied shoelaces knotting themselves together
f: Your shoe is untied. Made you look. Also it is.

sh: painted hills, lake and sky in a gold frame, sliding in
f: Nice view. Shame about the fight in front of it.

sh: flood of speech bubbles in a dozen alphabets
f: Bonjour. Hola. Konnichiwa. Bonk.

sh: stacked shells peeling away one at a time
f: Like an onion. Or a cake. Everybody likes cake.

sh: ceiling drip into an overflowing bucket
f: Plink. Plink. Plink. Plink. Plonk.

sh: narrow stone shelf with crumbling pebbles at the lip
f: Do not look down. You looked down.

sh: dented round dustbin lid held like a knight's shield
f: Knight of the bins. Fear the clang.

sh: thick leafy branch swung like a club
f: Out on a limb. Swinging it.

sh: unrolling paper scroll of tick boxes that never ends
f: Item 1: win. Item 2: see item 1.

sh: pump bottle squirting a slippery white puddle
f: Slippery hands. Dropped everything. Smells nice.

sh: gold velvet chaise with grapes, a fan and a tiny dog
f: Only the finest. Pinky out.

sh: blizzard of envelopes, postcards and one heavy parcel
f: You have got mail. All of it. At once.

sh: spreading sprawl of toys, crumbs, socks and spilled juice
f: Who made this? Nobody. It was always nobody.

sh: red squiggly underline and a pencil eraser rubbing a hole
f: Typos happen. This one bites.

sh: bowl of swirling purple-green gloop with a spoon standing up
f: Every drink at the fountain. In one cup.

sh: calendar page with thirty squares being crossed off
f: Thirty days hath September. The rest forgot.

sh: seven boxes in a row: five grey, two golden
f: Five days of Monday. Two days of bliss.

sh: humming racks of blinking lights joined by glowing cables
f: The server is down. Everyone panic.

sh: red BREAKING banner scrolling with a spinning globe
f: This just in: you. Getting hit. More at ten.

sh: jumbled letters, a fish on a bicycle and upside-down text
f: Flibber the wug went sproing. Exactly.

sh: taped brown box marked FRAGILE, rattling suspiciously
f: FRAGILE. This way up. Oops.

sh: rolling tartan grid that makes eyes go funny
f: Stare long enough and a sailboat appears.

sh: floppy yellow fruit skin lying in wait
f: The oldest trap in the book.

sh: blueprint with arrows, X marks and a doodled explosion
f: Step 1: summon. Step 2: ??? Step 3: win.

sh: floating quill and curling lines of verse
f: Roses are red. Violets are blue. Bonk.

sh: wooden steps, rocking chair and a swinging lantern
f: Get off my lawn. From the comfort of my chair.

sh: gold-framed stern painting whose eyes follow you
f: The eyes follow you. So does the frame, now.

sh: price tag whose number keeps flipping higher
f: It went up again. While you were reading this.

sh: pages shooting out of a jammed printer
f: PC LOAD LETTER. Paper jam. Low on cyan.

sh: evidence bag slammed on a desk with a spotlight
f: Pics or it did not happen. Here are the pics.

sh: giant pair of floating quotation marks clapping shut
f: "Live. Laugh. Launch." - A summon, probably.

sh: spreading red dots with frantic scratching hands
f: Do not scratch. You are scratching.

sh: wave of shaking fists, flying shoes and a flipped table
f: It started over the last slice of pizza.

sh: billowing white triangle on a mast, ropes snapping taut
f: Wind in the sail. Sail in your face.

sh: tiny paper cup with a cube of cheese on a toothpick
f: One per customer. Went round nine times.

sh: letterbox bars sliding in with SKIP flashing in the corner
f: Unskippable. Sit down.

sh: pink mist from a crystal bottle with a squeezy bulb
f: Three sprays is plenty. This was forty.

sh: colour-coded grid with every single slot filled in
f: You are double-booked. And late.

sh: razor swooping through a face-full of white foam
f: A close shave. Literally.

sh: swooping loopy pen scrawl ending in a flourish
f: Signed, sealed, delivered. To your face.

sh: ruler and two arrows, one pointing up, one down
f: It matters. Sometimes. In boss fights.

sh: steep tilted ground with a runaway shopping trolley
f: Slippery. Capital S. Capital WHEEE.

sh: podium with a microphone and endless cue cards
f: And in conclusion. Furthermore. One last thing.

sh: stubborn red-brown blot on a white shirt
f: It will not come out. Ever. Wear it proudly.

sh: needle looping red thread in a neat dotted line
f: A stitch in time saves nine hit points.

sh: black webbing strap ripping open with a velcro shriek
f: RRRRRRIP. The loudest fastener in class.

sh: spotless shiny slab you could see your face in
f: Wiped down. Slippery. Do not put that there.

sh: clipboard with five empty stars and fifty questions
f: Only takes two minutes. Question 1 of 94.

sh: wall of green wireframe panels with a blinking cursor
f: System error. Please restart the universe.

sh: red face with steam whistling out of both ears
f: Lost it. Cannot find it. Not looking.

sh: swirl of notes that everyone starts humming
f: Stuck in your head until Thursday.
